description: Problem: phase 3 showed that sections of change-framework, review-protocol and todo change behaviour once read, but Sonnet 5.5 rarely loads them unprompted: change-framework in 1/18 explicit and 0/18 implicit sessions, todo in 3/18 implicit, investigation-framework in 0/18. The code-first rule covers only the code skill. Rules such as no force-push and stop-after-local-commit therefore depend on something else putting the text in front of the model. Outcome: a tested mechanism that loads change-framework before the first commit or push, and todo before the first tracker write, or a recorded negative result. Decision gate, fixed before the runs: first establish whether omp can scope a rule to the triggering action (a shell git commit or push, omp's commit helper, a tracker tool call); if not, record the evidence and report options to the owner. Test on Sonnet with the trigger evaluation's prompts for each skill, 3 sessions per prompt, against no mechanism. At least 15 sessions per skill per arm must perform the triggering action; if the trigger prompts give fewer, add prompts that make the action likely, written into the pre-registration before scored runs. Adopt only if the skill is read in at least 80% of sessions that perform the triggering action, the mechanism fires in 0 near-miss sessions, and mean session cost rises by no more than 25%. Anything else is reported and not installed. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe, and through replay.py only after replay-disable-user-rules is merged; (2) change nothing under ~/.omp/agent, ~/.claude or ~/.agents while sessions run, upgrade neither omp, Claude Code nor tractable-mcp during a run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) commit the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision, Holm family and alpha) before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report; raising it needs the owner's approval in a later message; (5) record the omp, Claude Code and tractable-mcp versions with the results; never pool new sessions with results from another harness version; new comparisons form their own Holm family and published bands are left unchanged; (6) existing scenarios and pre-registration files are not edited: new arms use new scenario ids and a new pre-registration file, and run.py report or phase3_bands.py over the existing result folders gives the same output before and after; (7) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (8) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (9) a published number in a report is never rewritten: add a dated note after it; (10) scenario and scratch code that produced a result is committed with it; (11) if a result changes a claim in the blog post 'Testing agent instructions', correct the draft by PR; if the post is published, open a PR that adds a dated correction note and updates its 'updated' time, and merge it only after the owner approves in a later message, because a merge to main of joeharris76.com deploys the public site; (12) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; the item stays open until its PR is merged through the repository's usual flow (green CI, squash merge), and anything this item reserves for the owner is not merged or installed without the owner's message. Spend ceiling 60 USD. Spend gate: before the first paid session, tell the owner the ceiling and wait for a go-ahead in a later message; the item is blocked until then. Extra: sandbox rule files must have names not used in ~/.omp/agent/rules and be shown firing in a smoke session; nothing is installed in the user's configuration without the owner's approval of the measured result; skill descriptions are not changed in this item.
